name: read_sources_recovery
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,re
from html import unescape
p=Path.cwd();print('PREVIOUS', (p/'read_antichain_rainbow.receipt.json').read_text())
r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(p/'sources/antichain.pdf'),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'sources/antichain.txt'],input=r.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
print(r.stdout[:23000]);s=(p/'sources/rainbow-page.html').read_text();print('RAINBOW',unescape(re.sub('<[^>]+>',' ',s))[-16000:]);print('LINKS',re.findall(r'href="([^"]+)"',s))
